purpose: Single source of truth for how a section's photo and words relate. AI page designs default to one photo column beside one text column. Real pages also set words ON the photo, crop photos into circles, arches and pills, and run a very light image or pattern behind the words edge to edge. The wireframe declares one treatment per image slot, the prompts ask for it, the mockup keeps it, the HTML builds it in CSS, and QC measures it.
authority: Trevor's 2026-10-19 request: AI designs rarely put words on top of the image, rarely crop photos into circles, and never run a light full-width image behind words; those three families are re-admitted to the layout vocabulary. Go Full Page is the real-site example. The reference example files are for structure and look only, never for brand, palette, people, copy, signatures or dates.

tokens.rule: Every color in this file is a token. The run's brand file supplies the values. A hex value or a named color in this file is a defect.

universal_photo_prompt: No text, no lettering, no logos. Do not compose this as a website section; do not leave a blank column.
universal_section_negative: Do not split this section into an image column and a text column.
wireframe_annotations_allowed: Wireframe annotations are allowed on this sheet and are not copy: the section number and name, the type spec beside each text element, every image slot label with its pixel size, ratio and treatment, and the behavior note. Print nothing else that is not in the verbatim copy.

placeholders.{copy_side}: left or right, the side of the frame that holds the words (from the slot's copy_zone)
placeholders.{subject_side}: the opposite side, where the subject sits (from the slot's subject_zone)
placeholders.{copy_pct}: width of the reserved copy space as a whole percent of the frame
placeholders.{subject_pct}: width of the subject area as a whole percent of the frame
placeholders.{corner}: the quiet corner of the frame that holds a caption (top-left, top-right, bottom-left or bottom-right)
placeholders.{motifs}: the motifs from the slot, else the brand composition_cues imagery_direction, else a stated default
placeholders.{surface_color}: the brand's light ground as a hex value, filled at run time from the run's brand file (never stored in this file)
placeholders.{line_color}: the surface color shifted toward the ink color as far as the light-field contrast limit allows, a hex value computed at run time

treatments.when: Baseline. A photo column beside a text column. Use for at most 40 percent of photo-bearing sections; it is the default AI layout, not the target.
treatments.wireframe_drawing: Draw a rectangular image placeholder in one column and the text block in the other column.
treatments.photo_prompt: Subject framed for a rectangular crop with a calm, uncluttered edge toward the text column.
treatments.section_prompt: The photo sits in its own column beside the text column.

treatments.when: Hero and founder letter. The headline and short copy sit on a flat, bright copy zone of a full-bleed photo.
treatments.wireframe_drawing: Draw one full-width image placeholder as the section background. Draw the headline and copy block ON the placeholder inside the copy zone, and show the scrim as a tint that fades across the copy zone.
treatments.photo_prompt: Subject occupies only the {subject_side} {subject_pct} percent of the frame, eye line on the upper third. The {copy_side} {copy_pct} percent is one continuous, softly defocused, evenly lit plain surface (wall, sky or linen in the brand's neutral tone) with no objects, edges, highlights or texture: reserved copy space, brightness variation within about 6 percent. Do not center the subject. Do not fill the frame.
treatments.section_prompt: The photograph spans the full section width, edge to edge, as the section BACKGROUND. A gradient from the page surface color (solid from 0 to 35 percent of the width) to transparent (by 65 percent) lies between the photo and the headline. The headline and short copy sit ON the photograph inside the gradient zone on the {copy_side} side; the subject stays on the {subject_side} side.
treatments.css: section{position:relative} section>img{position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover} .copy{position:relative} optional scrim: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--brand-surface) 0 35%, transparent 65%)

treatments.when: Hero, why section, founder letter. A full-bleed photo with a dark gradient or solid scrim under light text.
treatments.wireframe_drawing: Draw one full-width image placeholder as the section background with a dark tint across the copy side and the headline and copy block drawn ON it.
treatments.photo_prompt: Low-key frame. The {copy_side} {copy_pct} percent falls off to the darkest tone with no detail; the subject is lit from the opposite side and sits in the {subject_side} {subject_pct} percent.
treatments.section_prompt: The photograph spans the full section width as the section BACKGROUND. A scrim from the darkest brand neutral (about 85 percent opaque from 0 to 40 percent of the width) fades to transparent (by 70 percent). The headline and copy sit ON the photograph in light type on the scrim side ({copy_side}).
treatments.css: same structure as overlay-light; scrim linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-dark) 85%, transparent) 0 40%, transparent 70%)

treatments.when: Pains and benefits. An eyebrow, a script accent or a 3 to 8 word caption set on a quiet corner of a photo. Caption words come only from the verbatim copy.
treatments.wireframe_drawing: Draw the caption text box ON the image placeholder, inside the quiet corner, with the slot label beside it.
treatments.photo_prompt: Keep the {corner} corner quiet: plain background, no faces, hands or busy detail in that 25 percent of the frame.
treatments.section_prompt: A short caption (an eyebrow, script accent or 3 to 8 words from the verbatim copy) sits ON the photograph in the {corner} corner, inside the quiet zone, away from any face.
treatments.css: figure{position:relative} figcaption{position:absolute; inset-inline:var(--space-4,1.5rem); bottom:var(--space-4,1.5rem)} caption box stays inside the declared copy_zone

treatments.when: Pains. A text card sits partly on the photo and partly off it, crossing the image edge.
treatments.wireframe_drawing: Draw the image placeholder and the text card overlapping it by a visible margin, the card drawn above the image.
treatments.photo_prompt: Keep the {copy_side} {copy_pct} percent of the frame calm and low in detail: a solid card will cover that part of the photo.
treatments.section_prompt: A solid text card in the page surface color overlaps the photograph: part of the card lies on the photo and part lies off it, crossing the photo's edge. The card sits above the photo.
treatments.css: grid overlap or negative margin; card background:var(--brand-surface); position:relative; z-index above the image

treatments.when: Why section and closing call to action. A full-width band with a dark photo or fabric texture behind light type.
treatments.wireframe_drawing: Draw a full-width band with an image placeholder behind it, a dark tint over the band and the type block drawn ON the band.
treatments.photo_prompt: Low-key frame. The {copy_side} {copy_pct} percent falls off to the darkest tone with no detail; texture or subject lit from the opposite side.
treatments.section_prompt: A full-width band, edge to edge. A dark photograph or fabric texture fills the band behind the type, under a scrim from the darkest brand neutral; the light headline and copy sit ON the band.

treatments.when: Solutions, what you get, how to, and the closing call to action alternate. A full-width, very light image or line-art pattern behind the type, edge to edge.
treatments.wireframe_drawing: Draw a light tint across the full page width behind the type block, with a faint pattern hint, and label it as a light field.
treatments.photo_prompt: Flat single-weight 1px line-art pattern of {motifs}, drawn as hairlines in {line_color} on a flat {surface_color} background, no shading, no photography, seamless tile, evenly spread with no focal point.
treatments.section_prompt: A very light line-art or image field runs the full page width, edge to edge, behind the headline and copy. The field is so light that the type reads at full contrast; it has no focal point and no subject.
treatments.css: background: var(--brand-surface) url(field.png); field pre-tinted so it stays within the field-to-surface contrast limit; or ::before with opacity 0.06 to 0.15

treatments.when: Who section personas, founder portrait. A photo cropped to a circle.
treatments.wireframe_drawing: Draw the image placeholder as a circle, not a rectangle, with the slot label beside it.
treatments.photo_prompt: Head-and-shoulders, face centered horizontally, top of head 12 percent below the frame top, chin at 62 percent of the frame height, plain background. Everything important sits inside the inscribed circle; the frame will be cropped round.
treatments.section_prompt: The photograph is cropped into a perfect circle; the circle shape is visible against the section background.

treatments.when: Benefits. A photo with a rounded top (an arch).
treatments.wireframe_drawing: Draw the image placeholder with a rounded top (an arch) and a flat base.
treatments.photo_prompt: Subject centered, at least 15 percent clear margin at both sides and the top; the frame will be cropped with a rounded top.
treatments.section_prompt: The photograph is cropped into an arch (rounded top, flat base); the arch shape is visible against the section background.

treatments.when: Who section alternate and small supporting photos. A photo in a stadium (pill) shape.
treatments.wireframe_drawing: Draw the image placeholder as a stadium (pill) shape.
treatments.photo_prompt: Subject centered, at least 15 percent clear margin at both sides and the top; the frame will be cropped with fully rounded edges.
treatments.section_prompt: The photograph is cropped into a pill (stadium) shape; the shape is visible against the section background.

treatments.when: Benefits alternate. A photo with an angled or curved cut edge.
treatments.wireframe_drawing: Draw the image placeholder with one angled or curved edge instead of a straight edge.
treatments.photo_prompt: Keep the subject at least 15 percent clear of the edge that will be cut at an angle; the frame will be cropped with an angled edge.
treatments.section_prompt: The photograph has one angled (or curved) cut edge instead of a straight edge; the cut is visible against the section background.

treatments.when: Hero alternate and founder letter. A portrait or object extends past its container's top or side edge into the next band.
treatments.wireframe_drawing: Draw the portrait placeholder crossing the top (or side) edge of its container by a visible margin.
treatments.photo_prompt: Subject cut-out friendly: clean separation from the background, full head and shoulders with headroom.
treatments.section_prompt: The portrait extends past the top edge of its container into the band above; it breaks the frame and the overlap is visible.
treatments.css: negative top margin on the figure; overflow:visible on the band

treatments.when: What you get. An element (a photo, card or badge) straddles the boundary between two sections.
treatments.wireframe_drawing: Draw the element sitting across the line between two section bands, drawn above both.
treatments.photo_prompt: Subject cut-out friendly with a clean edge; it will straddle the boundary between two bands.
treatments.section_prompt: One element (photo, card or badge) straddles the boundary between this section and the next, sitting above both backgrounds.
treatments.css: negative margin across the boundary; z-index above both bands

backdrop_disc: A solid brand-colored circle or arch BEHIND an unmasked cut-out subject (as in the hybrid board's hero) is a variant of mask-circle. It satisfies the shaped-crop budget only if the subject visibly overlaps the shape.

roles.description: 2A, 3A, 4A Solutions (long-form): type led on a light field
7 What you get: card grid on a light field
11 How-to: steps row on a light field
12 Founder letter: letter on the scrim side

budget.basis: Go Full Page A has about 13 overlays to 9 splits and B about 12 to 5; Trevor's Gen 2 mockups carry overlays in about 11 of 22 slots.
budget.note: A slot with no declared treatment counts as split. The budget applies to plans with at least applies_from_photo_sections photo-bearing sections; smaller plans (fixtures, single-section pages) are not judged.

legibility_rules.1: The text box never intersects the slot's declared subject_zone (no words over a face).
legibility_rules.2: Keep a 5 to 10 percent safe margin between overlaid text and the image or section edge.
legibility_rules.3: Contrast at the worse of the p5 and p95 backdrop luminance under the text box: body text under 24px at least 4.5:1; display text 24px or larger (or 18.66px bold) at least 3:1.
legibility_rules.4: Body copy over a photo needs a scrim or solid block at 55 percent opacity or more under it.
legibility_rules.5: Long body copy (more than 60 words) never sits directly on a photo; it goes on a card, the scrim side, or a plain band.
legibility_rules.6: Light field: the field behind the type (type and foreground elements hidden) is within field-to-surface contrast 1.15:1 of the brand surface and textured; text-to-field contrast meets rule 3. The ratio is the rule on every palette, light or dark; the absolute luminance 235 floor applies only when no surface color is known (Go Full Page measures 239 on its page).
legibility_rules.7: Busyness under text (standard deviation of the blurred backdrop, sigma 0.5 times the font size): at most 18/255 for body and 30/255 for display of 48px or larger. Ships as a warning until calibrated on the SPF015 set.

qc_checks.Q1: Section classifier from element boxes: OVERLAY when 60 percent or more of the headline box lies over an img or a box with a CSS background-image; SPLIT when image and text boxes do not overlap horizontally but share 50 percent or more vertically; STACK otherwise. The measured class must agree with the declared treatment, and the page must meet the budget.
qc_checks.Q2: Two-pass legibility render: render normally, then again with all text transparent. Sample the backdrop under each text box in the text-hidden render (the normal render gives false readings) and compute contrast against the computed text color, plus busyness.
qc_checks.Q3: Shape check for mask-circle, mask-arch, mask-pill and mask-diagonal: the four 8x8 corner patches of the img box match the section background (delta E under 3) and the center patch differs; also computed border-radius at least 50 percent or a clip-path other than none. Arch checks the top corners only.
qc_checks.Q4: Light-field check on the field behind the type, sampled in a render with the text and the foreground elements (buttons, cards, icons) hidden: field-to-surface contrast at most 1.15:1 on every palette, and luminance standard deviation at least 1.5, which proves the texture is present and not a flat fill.
qc_checks.Q5: Copy-space check on the raw generated photo, before the build: mean gradient magnitude inside copy_zone at most 25 percent of the frame mean. A failure means regenerate that slot (at most 2 retries, then flag).
qc_checks.Q6: Face-zone check: the text box and the slot's subject_zone do not intersect, with the slot geometry mapped to rendered pixels.
